Hi Lauren / Dominic — thanks for looping me in. Confirming Wed Oct 7, 11:00–11:45 PT. I'll lead the security portion and cover these specific items so your InfoSec team has what they need to assess risk:

Planned security walkthrough items:
- High-level architecture diagram + AWS account boundaries
- SOC 2 scope & latest report (we'll show mapping to Redwood controls)
- Access management (RBAC, SSO, audit logs) and retained log windows
- Data flows for customer data (in-flight, at-rest, backups)
- Encryption & key management (KMS/HSM options)
- Incident response / contact matrix and typical SLAs

Pen-test scope notes (we'll bring a draft):
- In-scope targets: inference endpoints, management console (non-prod copy for testing), and identity layer (subject to rate limits)
- Out-of-scope: third-party infra, shared cloud control planes, customer data in transit between customer and their network
- Preferred testing windows: weekdays 09:00–17:00 PT; emergency contact and kill-switch procedures will be provided

Process note: we'll provide a sanitized test environment for active exploitation where possible; for production-impacting tests we require a short change window and prior approval.

Attachments included for the call: SOC2-artifact-index.pdf; pen-test-scope-draft.pdf; simple-evidence-checklist.csv (attachment stub).

If you can share any specific compliance checklists or a short list of DPA points your legal wants clarified, Marissa will follow up with the DPA redline and timeline.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
